Some gear you trust your life to. The rest, you trust to a Nanuk case.

Since 1984, Plasticase — the company behind NANUK — has been engineering hard cases with a single obsession: make them indestructible. The name says it all. NANUK is derived from the Inuit word for Polar Bear — one of earth's most resilient predators, built to thrive in the most unforgiving environments on the planet. That's the standard every NANUK case is held to.

Engineered Where It Counts

NANUK cases are proudly designed and manufactured in Canada. It's not just a point of pride — it's a deliberate choice. Canada's harsh climate and demanding industrial standards create the ideal proving ground for cases that need to perform when failure isn't an option. Every case in the lineup — from compact Nano cases to large wheeled hard cases — is built with the same core commitments…
